name: fuzz-produce-done-no-reopen
description: Fuzz pbd385 (bot 1da6c62): Xxcha placed a flagship in Warfare's home build (production.produce answer), then pressed Done Producing Units within 3 s. The Done press closed the decision ('answered', message deleted) but the re-capture the place answer had scheduled 3 s later still read the message (its delete was in flight) and re-opened the decision under the same id (engine:answered-decision-reopened), a ghost prompt for a deleted message. Fix (bot fuzz-triage-2): recaptureLater skips a message whose decision was closed on purpose (answered / deleted) after the answer that scheduled it. Timing-dependent (Done within 3 s of the place answer, the delete in flight): the harness steps are usually slower, so this pins the flow; the race itself was checked by reading the code path (recaptureLater).
